title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - CountingObservation
description: Observation on the number of people or vehicles that a sensor counts (edintinf:CountingObservation, subclass of sosa:Observation).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CountingObservation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

madeBySensor.description: Relationship. The CountingSensor that made this observation (sosa:madeBySensor).

featureOfInterest.description: Relationship. The entity whose quality was observed (sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest).

observedProperty.description: Relationship. The property that was observed (sosa:observedProperty).

result.description: Property. The simple value of the observation, typically a people/vehicle count (sosa:hasSimpleResult). The source ontology does not constrain its datatype; left permissive.

resultTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant when the observation result was generated (sosa:resultTime).

phenomenonTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant or interval when the observed situation occurred (sosa:phenomenonTime).
